location.zh: 赫尔卡星 雷伊特训（湖边）

capture.zh: 雷伊特训第3关：只能派自己的雷伊出战，胜利后雷伊学会「元气电光球」。

strategy_notes.zh: 雷伊最好100级：闪电斗气强化几次双防后用大招；如果它复制了你的强化，就先用极光刃消强化，或用克电的草/地面系S级技能石秒杀。

engine_notes: Its own skill 属性复制 (20145) copies the player's stat changes — that is the '属性复制' the 4399 2012 guide warns about.
Below 1/8 HP every hit is a crit — trait of the 雷纳多 SPT boss (7k7k 2011), assumed to carry over.

雷伊特训 is a story line for the player's own 雷伊: only 雷伊 may fight (player_team_size 1 + require_player_species 70). The reward of each stage is a special skill learned by that 雷伊 (reward.learn_skill), not an essence; the engine needs a reward kind 'learn_skill {species, skill}' that adds the skill to the player's 雷伊's learnable list.
Skill ids 10823-10825 / 20363-20364 sit right after the 2009 skill range, so the training dates from late 2009 / early 2010.
Opponent levels and HP are not given by any source found; values are estimates.
skills: no source lists this opponent's skills; the species' top learnset skills are used.

Campaign audit correction: source-backed skill success requirement/reward mapping checked against official LeiyiTrainController.as and the period skill-training guide. The training 3/4 reward swap in the previous reconstruction is corrected.
source_note: 7k7k 2011-07 雷伊解析 lists the five 特训 opponents and how to beat them; baidu jingyan gives the skill order and the 5-turn shadow limit.
